_about: Inputs of scripts/business_case.py that are not in data/prices_2026.json (exchange rate, AWS server-hour prices, Titan/Cohere prices, hardware per server and write-off years come from there, via scheduler.pricing). Each entry: value, unit, source. 'research' = research_notes/prices_and_costs.md (read 2026-11-21, URLs there). 'our assumption' = not sourced, ours.

electricity_household_chf_kwh.source: ElCom 2026, IWB Basel, H4 total (data/raw/elcom_iwb_H4_2025_2026.json); research confirms

heat_pump_cop.source: case brief; research: Swiss field tests measured SPF 3.19 for air-water (2.47-4.04), so 2.5 is conservative

owner_example_heating_chf_per_year.source: case owner, 21 Nov 2026; research: heat pump running cost CHF 1,000-1,600/yr (EnergieSchweiz)

heat_pump_install_chf.source: research: air-water heat pump CHF 45-60k installed (EnergieSchweiz), midpoint

heat_pump_subsidy_bs_chf.source: research: Basel-Stadt CHF 8,000 + 250/kW (10 kW unit), max 40 %

heat_discount_base.source: our assumption; case owner: discount vs heat pump (model 30 % and 50 %), not free heat

compute_premium.source: our assumption; case owner: we can charge more than Amazon (local, controlled, private, green, Swiss)

backlog_price_chf_per_server_h.source: our assumption, conservative: unsold server-hours run backlog work that earns nothing

redundancy_markup_per_copy.unit: share of base price per extra copy
redundancy_markup_per_copy.source: our assumption; research: AWS charges a full 2x for RDS Multi-AZ, so +50 % per copy undercuts the cloud's redundancy price

ram_chf_per_gb.source: research: DDR5 64 GB RDIMM contract Q4 2026 USD 1,586 (Citi projection, low confidence). Used only as the base of the RAM sensitivity: the server price in prices_2026.json already includes 2026 memory

ram_chf_per_gb_retail.source: research: retail USD 2,561 per 64 GB, Nov 2026

site_install_chf.source: research estimates: 1,000 L tank ~CHF 4,000 installed + plumbing CHF 5-15k (10k) + controls/network CHF 2,000 (our assumption)

servers_per_site_typ.source: our assumption: services fleet averages 56/6 = 9.3, homes 4

drycooler_chf_per_kw.source: research estimate: 5-10 kW dry cooler CHF 3-5k + CHF 1,500 install, ~CHF 5,500 per 10 kW

maintenance_share_of_capex.source: research: planning value 10 % of capex (third-party 8-15 %, OEM ~20 %)

ops_chf_per_server_year.source: our assumption: monitoring, software, on-call share

sold_share_base.unit: share of running server-hours sold at the full price
sold_share_base.source: our assumption; the rest runs backlog work, counted at zero revenue (conservative)

friend_aws_simulation_usd_per_year.source: case owner: a friend pays ~12k/yr on AWS for simulation compute

services.name: Local embeddings / RAG indexing
services.throughput_source: measured items/server-h (workloads.catalog) x tokens_per_abstract; price and tokens from data/prices_2026.json
services.price_source: data/prices_2026.json (Titan Text Embeddings V2); Google: research, Vertex Gemini Embedding
services.buyers: law firms, insurers, hospitals, cantonal administration (documents that must not leave)

services.name: Search reranking
services.price_source: data/prices_2026.json (Cohere Rerank 3.5 on Bedrock); Google: research, Ranking API
services.buyers: same as embeddings: the second step of a private search/RAG pipeline

services.name: Image tagging
services.throughput_source: our assumption: ~280 images/s with a CLIP ViT-B/32-class model on a 128-core CPU server (order of magnitude, not measured)
services.price_source: research: Rekognition DetectLabels Frankfurt; Google Vision labels
services.buyers: museums and archives (collection photos), retailers, pharma lab imaging

services.name: People counting (video)
services.throughput_source: our assumption: 100 real-time streams sampled at 5 fps per server (small detector on CPU)
services.price_source: research: Rekognition Video Frankfurt; Google Video Intelligence person detection
services.buyers: public transport (SBB, BVB, BLT), venues, retail, municipalities

services.name: Transcription
services.throughput_source: our assumption: 50 audio-hours per server-hour (Whisper-small class, int8, CPU, batched)
services.price_source: research: AWS Transcribe batch Zurich (USD 0.006, not the older 0.024); Google STT V2 standard
services.buyers: hospitals (patient conversations), courts, cantonal administration, bodycam audio

services.name: Simulations (CFD, molecular dynamics, Monte Carlo)
services.throughput_source: data/prices_2026.json: our reference server (2x EPYC 9654) = AWS c7a.48xlarge
services.buyers: pharma and biotech R&D, engineering offices, universities (sciCORE)

services.name: Video compression (HD)
services.throughput_source: our assumption: 10x real-time HD x264 encodes on 128 cores
services.price_source: research: MediaConvert Basic HD (legacy SKU, conservative); Google Transcoder HD
